phrases.speak: What if one slash command could turn an ordinary video into professional motion graphics?
phrases.show: What if one slash command could turn an ordinary video into professional motion graphics?

phrases.speak: These are custom Claude Code skills, built with Remotion and animation components. They are not built in commands. Each one is a small folder with instructions.
phrases.show: Custom Claude Code skills, built with Remotion. Not built-in commands.

phrases.speak: Skills live in the dot claude skills folder. Type a slash, pick the skill, and Claude follows its instructions to render the result.
phrases.show: Skills live in .claude/skills. Type /, pick the skill, Claude renders it.

phrases.speak: One. Slash U I depth reel. A flat recording lifts into depth, with floating panels.
Two. Slash scrapbook collage. Cutouts and real screenshots pop in, layer by layer.
Three. Slash news broadcast. A studio layout with lower third. A style demo, never live news.
Four. Slash neon outline. The glow follows the real silhouette of the robot.
Five. Slash agentoon number motion. Counters, rings and bars, all driven by the frame.
Six. Slash agentoon three D showcase. A real three D logo rotates, with floating screens.
Seven. Slash agentoon kinetic type. Words land exactly when you say them.
Eight. Slash agentoon data flow. Packets travel along the highlighted A P I path.
Nine. Slash agentoon cinematic cuts. Two scenes joined by a motion matched cut.
Ours are custom local skills. Build your own the same way, with one skill dot M D file.
phrases.show: Custom local skills. Build your own with one SKILL.md file.

phrases.speak: Which slash skill would you try first? Save this video and follow Agentoon dot A I for more Claude Code tutorials!
phrases.show: Which slash skill would you try first? Save this video and follow @agentoon.ai
